columns.metric: ar_recall = Attacker-Reachable Vulnerability Recall; localized_recall = DeepSec's metric (never rank or combine with ar_recall)
columns.macro_recall_pct: mean of the 20 per-application recalls, percent, 1 dp
columns.matched: pooled count of matched reference vulnerabilities
columns.interval95_*: 95% interval from 4,000 resamples of the 20 applications (seed 20260929)
columns.precision_pct: matched / findings, pooled; a lower bound
columns.matched_exact_line / matched_file_level: endpoint rule at 0 lines / any line in the right file; counterfactual rescorings, empty for DeepSec

basis: main runs, one per configuration and application; frozen reference set
derivation_note: Rows in the paper's order. Produced by the VulnBench 2.0 analysis pipeline, which verifies the archive's SHA-256, extracts it, and re-scores every run with a re-implementation of the public scorer that reproduces every recorded scoring decision; this file is a selection and renaming of the pipeline's output.
empty_cells: An empty cell means not applicable or unavailable; it never means zero.
